title: Board Play Edges From To Fixture
description: Board play stopped rendering edges: Nakagin fixture JSON still uses edge keys `from`/`to` while TS parser and Rust paths expected `source`/`target`. Fixed TS parseBoardFixtureV1 to normalize endpoints; extended Rust scene_json helper fixture_edge_handle_ids_from_object and wired force_graph, hierarchical_tree, redraw_layout, board_host fixture sync; fixed raw string delimiter in svg_icon test. Vitest board package passed; wasm32 cargo check passed (native Windows cargo test blocked by wgpu/windows duplicate).
summary: Restored board play edges when fixtures use legacy `from`/`to` on edges: TS `parseBoardFixtureV1` maps those to `source`/`target`; Rust `fixture_edge_handle_ids_from_object` is used in force_graph, hierarchical_tree, redraw_layout, and board_host fixture→descriptor sync so WASM layout and host stay aligned. Re-exported helper at crate root; fixed `r#"…"#` SVG test literal that broke on `fill="#"` by using `r##"…"##`. Verified `cargo check -p elements_board --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` and `bunx vitest run` in `elements/client/lib/board` (56 tests). Full `nx run @elements/board:test` still fails on this Windows host because `cargo test` compiles native wgpu/DX12 with conflicting `windows` crate versions (environment issue, not this change).
